description: This PHP source file defines the class CalendarViewCreateInvitee, which handles the creation of invitee records (Leads or Contacts) within the Calendar module of the SuiteCRM project. It manages pre-display logic like access control and bean initialization, as well as rendering a JSON response with the invitee's data.

classes.name: CalendarViewCreateInvitee
classes.description: Handles the creation and data retrieval of invitee records (Leads or Contacts) in the Calendar module, with access control and JSON response output.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Performs access control, loads the appropriate bean (Lead or Contact), and saves it if the user has write access.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares a JSON response with selected fields from the bean for output.

methods.name: returnNoAccess
methods.description: Outputs a JSON indicating lack of access and terminates the script.
